inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize speech audio from measured articulatory kinematics (EMA, PMA or other magnetic tracking) and report how acoustic features are turned into a waveform. Boundary: exclude acoustic-to-articulatory inversion, talking-head animation and articulatory synthesizers driven by model parameters rather than measurements; count versions once.
